title: A point of a limit is the limit of its images
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ and projections $f_i:S\to S_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $s\in S$ and $s_i=f_i(s)$. Then the field maps $\kappa(s_i)\to\kappa(s_{i'})$ ($i'\ge i$) and $\kappa(s_i)\to\kappa(s)$ induced by $f_{i'i}$ and $f_i$ [def-weil-residue-field] make $\kappa(s)$ the directed colimit $\varinjlim_i\kappa(s_i)$ in commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; equivalently $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with the morphisms $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_i)$, is the limit of the inverse system $(\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_i))_i$ (whose transition morphisms are affine) in the category of schemes, compatibly with the canonical morphisms $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_i)\to S_i$ and $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S$.

proof.text: Construct the residue-field diagram and cocone by transporting the canonical residue maps along the cone identities. Scheme.residueFieldMap_id and Scheme.residueFieldMap_comp prove the laws. The transported maps are heterogeneously equal to the original maps.

Lift a residue element through Scheme.residue_surjective to the stalk. Mathlib isBasis_preimage_isAffineOpen and TopCat.Presheaf.exists_mem_germ_eq_of_isBasis represent it by a section on an inverse image of an affine open of a stage. The restricted diagram is affine and limiting by isLimitOpensCone. Apply exists_appTop_π_eq_of_isAffine_of_isLimit to descend the section to a later stage, using the canonical topIso maps on the open subschemes. Evaluation naturality shows that its stage residue maps to the prescribed residue element. This implements the affine-neighbourhood reduction of Stacks 0CUG using the existing Mathlib section-descent API.

The canonical cocone maps are injective ring maps from fields. Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' therefore recognizes the underlying cocone as a colimit: the images cover by the preceding step and equality at one stage already follows by injectivity. The forgetful functor from commutative rings preserves filtered colimits and reflects isomorphisms, so reflectsColimit_of_reflectsIsomorphisms and isColimitOfReflects give the ring colimit.

The spectrum functor preserves limits; map the opposite ring cocone to obtain the limiting scheme cone. All spectrum transition maps are affine. Scheme.Hom.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField proves each projection and transition compatibility equation.

lean.statement: theorem exists_isColimit_residueField_of_isLimit {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (s : c.pt) : ∃ (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (r : Cocone R), (∀ i : I, R.obj i = (D.obj (op i)).residueField (c.π.app (op i) s)) ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), HEq (R.map f) ((D.map f.op).residueFieldMap (c.π.app (op j) s))) ∧ r.pt = c.pt.residueField s ∧ (∀ i : I, HEq (r.ι.app i) ((c.π.app (op i)).residueFieldMap s)) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit r) ∧ (∃ t : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec), t.pt = Spec (c.pt.residueField s) ∧ (∀ i : I, HEq (t.π.app (op i)) (Spec.map ((c.π.app (op i)).residueFieldMap s))) ∧ Nonempty (IsLimit t) ∧ ∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom ((R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec).map f)) ∧ (∀ i : I, Spec.map ((c.π.app (op i)).residueFieldMap s) ≫ (D.obj (op i)).fromSpecResidueField (c.π.app (op i) s) = c.pt.fromSpecResidueField s ≫ c.π.app (op i)) ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), Spec.map ((D.map f.op).residueFieldMap (c.π.app (op j) s)) ≫ (D.obj (op i)).fromSpecResidueField (D.map f.op (c.π.app (op j) s)) = (D.obj (op j)).fromSpecResidueField (c.π.app (op j) s) ≫ D.map f.op)
